intro: Over eight articles published between April 22 and May 14, 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of the recorded-future tag highlighted activity from threat actors Cobalt Strike and LockBit. These actors were observed targeting financial services, government, e-commerce, enterprise, and healthcare sectors. Affected regions included the Caribbean, China, the EU, global, and Latin America. The severity mix across these reports comprised two medium, one informational, and three high severity assessments.
